title: Title Services Schedule — Interstate Transport Surcharge on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Surcharge.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, an order registered through an out-of-state title service carries an interstate transport surcharge on the transfer shipping fee. The service is the service type of the order's Title & Registration Services order.

| Title & Registration Services order | Interstate transport surcharge |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | $70.00 (the interstate inspection surcharge) |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | $45.00 (the interstate surcharge) |
| Kestrel Title-Only Service, Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer, Kestrel In-State New Registration or Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | none |

The surcharge is added to the transfer shipping fee after the carrier price has been reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Discounted transfer price $499.00, title service Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection: $569.00.
- Discounted transfer price $745.00, Kestrel Out-of-State Registration: $790.00.
- Discounted transfer price $799.00, Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer: $799.00.
